card.what: The lesson boat's kicker: a 4-6 hp single-cylinder long-shaft four-stroke on a parallel-arm transom bracket, tiller arm folded up while sailing, red coiled kill cord
card.boats: J/22 hero (Inputs/j22-hero/j22_outboard.py, part of the hull); the fleet's kit Outboard35 (C22, Corsair, berthed) is a later pass
card.distance: a metre or two from the helm, looking aft and down over the port quarter
card.before: the October hero build: a squat domed cowl, the tiller arm lying forward over the aft deck, a glossy black finish, a 0.62 m shaft and a stainless bracket

references.use: the look and proportions: Bean's lesson photos IMG_9273 (the motor from the helm, crop with no people), IMG_9266 and 1000032829 (Rush Creek, Oct 2026); private, never in the repo
